comparator.sourceNotes: Adopted 2026–2027 VUmc-compas OER articles 11.1–11.5 and 12.1–12.4 establish 180 EC: first year ten 6-EC units; second year ten 6-EC units; third year minor 24 + thesis 6 + five 6-EC units. Major 156 EC already includes the thesis. Amsterdam Global Health is the first-listed 24-EC faculty minor, selected neutrally without considering UCR fit; admission, selection, capacity and annual availability apply. It is a minor choice, not a separate formal degree route. External minors alternatively require approval, at most 6 EC at level 100 and at least 12 at level 300, no content overlap and no placement as the minor. The extra 6-EC minor literature thesis in article 12.2.2 applies to visiting non-Medicine students, not this Medicine student; it is not added. Praktijkstage Zorg carries 6 EC once. General-practice placement and Kennismaking Wetenschappelijk Onderzoek 1/2 are embedded in Arts en patiënt 4 and Arts en patiënt 2/4; they receive no additional invented EC. The Dutch language test, professional behaviour and integrated assessments are embedded. VUMED360 begins September 2027; Fall 2026 entrants follow the outgoing Compas B1/B2/B3 sequence, with final full teaching in 2026–2027/2027–2028/2028–2029 and results expiring 31 August 2030. This does not combine Compas and VUMED360.

alternatives.concept: Study normal human function, molecular and organ-system disease, pharmacology, brain function and the psychological experience of illness, with experimental evidence and public-health foundations. This is a related-fields response to Medicine, not a medical degree or a clinical-practice pathway.

alternatives.concept: Retain the biomedical disease and treatment foundation while investigating population health, social influences on illness, diversity, rights and community inclusion. The target’s humane socially grounded medicine and diversity interests, together with its selected Global Health minor, support this organising direction.

alternatives.labelRationale: The curriculum retains substantial biomedicine and replaces specialist neurocognitive and therapeutic depth with social, qualitative and rights-based investigation of health populations.
alternatives.distinctnessRationale: Four courses / 30 EC differ in each programme: neurobiology, higher cognitive functions, psychodiagnostics/psychotherapies and lifespan psychology are replaced by social psychology, qualitative research, contemporary social theory and human rights. These changes implement the social-inclusion concept rather than arbitrary breadth.

alternativeSelection.assessment: The biomedical/psychological core and a distinct social population-health direction support two complete curricula. A further patient-contact concept cannot be supplied by the workbook: anatomy demonstrations, laboratory cases and academic psychodiagnostics are not supervised medical placements or a physician clinical-skills sequence. Other generating interests are substantively represented in the included concepts and do not support a third independent programme.

notes.text: VU Medicine integrates biomedical systems with clinical reasoning, patient encounters and professional medical formation. UCR can support biomedicine, neuroscience, health psychology and population-health inquiry, but these programmes do not reproduce the full clinical Medicine curriculum or its supervised care placements.
